actions: Verified sanitized root control and self_improvement role config with repeated SHA-only note main lookup before semantic work.
Continued from sequence 75 without reading O, other workers, downstream state, legacy research or shared aggregate receipts/ledger.
Audited public crash/resume contracts, semantic rollback evidence and durable accounting implementation.
Separated recovery into resume-plane conformance, semantic rollback admissibility, controller/accounting durability and a still-unvalidated evaluation-consumption transaction layer.
Persisted a source-bound machine-readable recovery semantics contract and sequence-76 checkpoint.
Advanced role-local LATEST from sequence 75 to 76 using CAS and verified readback.

new_evidence.resume_plane: Resume Means Resume provides PC/EO/FD/CV/CO/RD plus deterministic fault testing including real SIGKILL and external durable effect observation; ordinary interrupts are not treated as crash equivalence.
new_evidence.semantic_rollback: DART provides same-runtime matched evidence that latest admissible frozen-state recovery can retain success with much less replay/latency than whole-task restart while unsafe entry-only local recovery fails in commitment-sensitive cases.
new_evidence.sandbox_layer: Crab provides a lower-level semantics-aware sandbox checkpoint/restore result and is explicitly kept separate from workflow/controller semantic admissibility.
new_evidence.accounting_durability: Iterion persists tokens/cost/iterations/elapsed/cumulative spend and has a direct test that a resumed over-budget checkpoint fails before restart-node execution rather than receiving a fresh budget.
new_evidence.derived_gap: No source in this run establishes durable exactly-once/monotone evaluation-query, selection-feedback and statistical-spend consumption for self-improvement across crash/retry.

blocker: No single public real-LLM self-improvement system was confirmed to compose real-kill resume conformance, semantic rollback admissibility, durable accounting plus evaluation/statistical consumption, common-budget Continue/restart/rewind/redirect comparison, complete chronology and a selection-unused outer test.
termination_cause: runtime turn boundary after durable checkpoint/readback; frontier remains nonempty
exact_next_action: Search for a public controller composing real-kill resume-plane conformance, semantic rollback admissibility and durable evaluation/query/statistical-spend consumption. Audit durable runtimes specifically for process-death equivalence of accounting/effects without upgrading ordinary resume tests to SIGKILL evidence. In parallel search for a same-system common-total-budget comparison covering Continue, whole/clean restart, artifact-preserving rewind and strategy redirect under a selection-unused outer test. If absent, search specifically for an implementation of the proposed Evaluation Consumption Contract with durable query IDs, score/feedback lineage, monotone statistical spend and restart-safe promotion decisions.
